title: MM-BrowseComp: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Multimodal Browsing Agents
abstract: arXiv:2508.13186v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: AI agents with advanced reasoning and tool-use capabilities have demonstrated impressive performance in web browsing for deep search. However, existing benchmarks such as BrowseComp primarily focus on textual content, overlooking the prevalence of multimodal content. To bridge this gap, we introduce MM-BrowseComp, a novel benchmark comprising 400 challenging, hand-crafted questions designed to evaluate multimodal retrieval and reasoning capabilities. Unlike prior work, MM-BrowseComp incorporates visual prompts and necessitates the extraction of key evidence from web images and videos to complete questions, rendering text-only approaches insufficient. Additionally, we provide a verified checklist for each question, enabling fine-grained analysis of multimodal dependencies and reasoning paths. Our comprehensive evaluation of 27 state-of-the-art models reveals that even leading models like GPT-5-High with tools achieve only 24.25\

translated_title: MM-BrowseComp：面向多模态浏览智能体的综合基准测试
translated_abstract: 具备先进推理和工具使用能力的AI智能体在网络浏览深度搜索方面已展现出令人瞩目的表现。然而，现有的基准测试（如BrowseComp）主要关注文本内容，忽视了多模态内容的普遍存在。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了MM-BrowseComp，这是一个包含400个手工制作的高难度问题的新型基准测试，旨在评估多模态检索与推理能力。与以往工作不同，MM-BrowseComp融入了视觉提示，并要求从网络图像和视频中提取关键证据来完成问题，这使得仅依赖文本的方法难以胜任。此外，我们为每个问题提供了经过验证的核对清单，支持对多模态依赖关系和推理路径进行细粒度分析。我们对27个最先进模型的全面评估表明，即使是配备工具的顶尖模型（如GPT-5-High）也仅达到24.25%的准确率
tldr: 本文提出MM-BrowseComp基准，包含400个需要从网页图像和视频中提取证据的多模态浏览问题，评估显示即使是配备工具的最先进模型（如GPT-5-High）准确率也仅达24.25%，凸显了多模态浏览智能体的巨大挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MM-BrowseComp, a benchmark of 400 challenging multimodal questions requiring evidence extraction from web images and videos, revealing that even state-of-the-art models like GPT-5-High with tools achieve only 24.25% accuracy, highlighting the significant challenges facing multimodal browsing agents.
